title: TAMS Video Rendition
description: A piece of video content stored in TAMS

id.description: Unique identifier for use with LPX API endpoints.

sourceId.description: The TAMS source ID for the rendition.

href.description: URL directing to the TAMS store. Suggest using the /sources/{source_id} endpoint, but should at least provide the network location of the TAMS store.

tags.description: A list of tags associated with the rendition.
